risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.36) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 57 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) combined with contrarian congressional buying and fear-zone sentiment (34 Fear & Greed) create a classic bounce setup with support at 149.97 nearby.
